# CloseDir

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
CloseDir dir:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | Int32 | required | The folder handle. |

## Description

Closes a folder that was opened with [ReadDir](ReadDir).
